why_a_second_manifest: Nine of the twenty entries are scripts and test modules outside simulation-results-ct2i/. Every key in PACKAGE_SHA256.json is resolved relative to the package directory by verify_package_checksums.in_package(), so a 'scripts/...' key there would resolve inside the package and report MISSING ON DISK forever. Keys here are relative to the REPOSITORY ROOT. scripts/verify_package_checksums.py verifies both manifests and exits non-zero if either disagrees with disk.
generator_script: ad hoc, scratchpad only, not committed; every entry is re-derivable from scripts/verify_package_checksums.py, which shares no code with it
excluded_note: 00_README.md is excluded because it carries the Option A provenance stamp token (AUTHORITATIVE COMMIT), which scripts/stamp_provenance.py rewrites after the commit exists; its hash therefore changes at stamp time. It stays covered by PACKAGE_SHA256.json, which is regenerated after every stamp. Keeping it out of this manifest makes this manifest stamp-invariant: no entry here contains a stamp token, so these hashes are valid both before and after stamping. scripts/verify_package_checksums.py is excluded because it is the instrument that checks this manifest; hashing the checker inside the thing it checks would add no independent assurance.
self_reference_guard: The file list is enumerated literally in the generator; no glob is used, so no pattern can sweep in the manifest being written. The generator asserts that no entry's basename is one of ['A0_1_DELIVERABLES_SHA256.json', 'PACKAGE_SHA256.json', 'PACKAGE_SHA256SUMS.txt'] before hashing anything, and scripts/verify_package_checksums.py re-asserts self-entries == 0 on every run and FAILS if it is not.
stamp_token_policy: VALID PRE- AND POST-STAMP. No file listed here contains PENDING_STAMP_SEE_PACKAGE_PROVENANCE, PENDING_ZIP_SHA256_SEE_SHA256SUMS or PENDING_ZIP_BYTES_SEE_SHA256SUMS (verified by grep at generation time), so scripts/stamp_provenance.py cannot change any of these hashes. PACKAGE_SHA256.json is the manifest that IS stamp-sensitive; per ruling D15 it is regenerated last, after stamping.
